human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add a projection service that loads one stored run, builds ExecutionProjection, derives GovernanceSignals, and atomically upserts/replaces derived rows. Rebuild must never alter raw run/events/decisions/evidence. Dependency: 8014.add-governance-signal-rules.
human_pressure.why_now: Report and fleet queries need a supported rebuild path instead of scattered writes from import or UI code.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement one-run deterministic projection rebuild service with derived storage persistence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8014.add-governance-signal-rules. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: One run rebuild is the primitive used by later CLI/backfill/API.
failure_semantics: Projection failure leaves prior raw evidence intact and does not mark raw run as clean/failed by projection guess.

steps.title: Build projection then signals
details: No partial persistence before successful derivation.

steps.title: Persist transactionally enough
details: Upsert projection and replace signals for run.

steps.title: Test rebuild idempotency
details: Changed raw evidence yields changed derived state after rebuild.

acceptance: Rebuild creates exactly one projection per run.
Repeated rebuild does not duplicate signals.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/signals.py src/ailuros/storage/sqlite_storage.py

reject_if: Import and projection are coupled into an irreversible transaction.
Raw events are rewritten to match projection.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
